footer.blurb: Government paperwork in Rwanda, checked, filed and followed up for you.
footer.disclaimer: Inzira is a private, independent assistance company. We are not Irembo, RRA, RDB, RURA, the land administration or any government institution, and we do not give legal advice. Official fees and taxes are set and collected by the relevant institution; our assistance fee is separate and always shown on its own line.

legal.privacyLead: What Inzira keeps about you, and for how long.
legal.who: {legal} is a private company in {city}. We are not a government institution, and we are not Irembo. Write to {email} or call {phone}.
legal.collect: We ask for your name and email to open a request. A phone number is optional, for a call or WhatsApp. We ask for a national ID only when the service needs one, and we say so before you type it. You also send the documents that service requires. We keep the payment reference for money you pay us.
legal.not: We do not look you up in a government register. We do not search NIDA, Irembo or RRA. A 16-digit number is not proof that an identity card exists, or that it is yours.
legal.keep: Documents you upload are deleted {days} days after the request is finished, or sooner when you ask. Certificates we send you stay in your account until you delete it. Payment records stay, because they are accounts. If you delete your account, those records stay without your name, email or phone number.
legal.see: The person handling your request can see what you sent. We send an institution only what that filing needs. We do not sell your details.
legal.delete: You can delete your account when no request is still open. Your name, email, phone and files are removed. You can also ask us to delete the documents of a finished request before the {days} days are up.
legal.termsLead: What we do for you, what we charge, and what we cannot decide.
legal.do: Inzira prepares a request, files it through the official channel and follows it up. We are a private company. We are not the institution, and we do not decide the outcome.
legal.fees: Every service shows two amounts before you pay. The official fee is set by the institution. Usually you pay it to them, and the receipt is in your name. Our fee pays for checking, preparing, filing and following up. It is agreed before we start. When an official fee passes through us, we do not add to it.
legal.decide: Only the institution can approve or refuse an application. We file a complete request and follow it up. We cannot promise the result.
legal.stop: You can ask us to stop before the request is filed. Our fee is refunded when the work has not started, and the refund is recorded on the request. An official fee already paid to the institution follows that institution’s rules.
legal.docs: Send documents you have the right to share. We use them only for that request. The privacy page says how long we keep them.
legal.company: {legal} meets people by appointment in {city}. Call {phone} or write to {email}.

contact.waPrefill: Hello Inzira, I need help with a request.

home.deletedBody: Your details and documents are gone. Payment records stay, without your name or number.
home.lead: Registration, taxes, land, transport permits, police services and certificates for people and businesses in Rwanda. We check your documents, file them through the official channel and follow up until it’s done.
home.caseLabel: Example: a company registration on its way through RDB
home.filedWith: Requests are sent to these offices
home.filedNote: The marks name the office a request goes to. Inzira is a private company. We do not represent these institutions, and they do not endorse us.
home.feesLead: Our fee for each service is fixed and agreed before we start.
home.feesNote: The official fee is set by the institution and shown on each service before you pay. Usually you pay it to them directly, with the receipt in your name. When it passes through us, it is never marked up.
home.howLead: Four steps, and only the first one needs you. One person handles your request from start to finish.
home.s1d: Pick a service, or describe your situation in English, Kinyarwanda or French. Asking is free.
home.s2d: You hear exactly what is missing before anything is filed. Most rejections start here.
home.s3d: Through the institution’s official channel. You get the reference number, and we chase it if it stalls.
home.s4d: The certificate and the official receipt arrive in your account and on WhatsApp.
home.a1: {legal} is a private Rwandan company in {city}. Our team prepares, files and follows up government procedures for businesses and professionals who would rather spend their time on their work. You can always do these procedures yourself; we save you the queues, the forms and the follow-up.
home.q2: Are you part of the government or Irembo?
home.a2: No. Inzira is a private, independent company. We file through the official channels on your behalf. Every decision is made by the institution.
home.a3: The official fee or tax goes to the institution, exactly as they set it, and often you pay it to them directly. Our fee pays for checking, preparing, filing and following up. You see both before you pay.
home.q4: Can you guarantee my application is approved?
home.a4: No one can; only the institution decides. We make sure your request is complete and correct when it is filed, and we follow it up.
home.q5: What if my service isn’t listed?
home.a5: Tell us what you need. We often help with other online procedures, and we agree the process and our fee with you before we start.
home.closeTitle: Talk to a person before you start.
home.closeLead: Tell us what you need on WhatsApp, by phone or by email. We’ll tell you the procedure, the documents and both fees, free and before you commit.
home.searchLabel: What do you need to do?
home.searchPh: For example: register a company, trading licence
home.browseLead: Six places a request can go. Open one to see the documents and both fees before you commit.
home.twoLead: You see both amounts on every service before you pay, and approve each one.
home.twoOfficialD: Set and collected by the institution. Usually you pay it to them directly, with the receipt in your name. When it passes through us, it is never marked up.
home.twoOursD: Fixed and agreed before we start. It pays for checking, preparing, filing and following up.
